study.question: Can the orthogonal redundant-coordinate reduction retain its near-native click AUC with cheaper execution, and can a direct reduced inference affine lower measured prediction latency under the frozen protocol?
study.hypothesis: Observation: native g2-r0074-coordinate_reference produced click AUC0.6675018907227037, dense200563, train332.518s, p50/p95=14.499/14.614ms. Plain quotient at equal nonlinear64/32 widths produced0.6672800038030104, dense194419, train314.374s, p50/p95=14.568/14.682ms. Orthogonal quotient produced0.6674691908161241, the same194419 dense parameters, train339.742s, p50/p95=14.840/14.996ms. Neither quotient established prediction latency utility; the orthogonal quality result is a promising single-seed observation. The nearly parameter-matched width50 control produced0.6661639445367832, and first56 width/scale rescue branches also lost AUC (0.6670890456047657 and0.6665819135356411). These failures do not show that every capacity reduction fails. Mechanism: for u=(q+k)/sqrt2 and v=sqrt(3/2)*(q-k), the stored orthogonal affine A*u+B*v+P*(q*k)+C*a+b equals (A/sqrt2+sqrt(3/2)*B)*q+(A/sqrt2-sqrt(3/2)*B)*k+P*(q*k)+C*a+b. Derive these effective weights inside forward while retaining A,B as the actual trainable parameters; this retains the orthogonal optimization coordinates and removes expanded per-history input transforms. This differs from training independent plain q/k weights. A separate evaluation-only replacement computes one reduced dense affine instead of hoisted target/history affines and output summation. It removes launches but repeats target arithmetic; whether it lowers latency is uncertain and explicitly falsifiable. The inherited explicit/orthogonal quality difference is not proof of an optimization mechanism, and algebraic equivalence is not BF16 identity. Predeclared next-screen AUC preservation margin is0.000100 against the stronger contemporaneous native incumbent (historical floor0.6674018907227037), without weakening any earlier campaign criterion. Prediction-cost criterion is>=2% lower whole-batch p50 with<=2% p95 regression, followed by paired timing replay and<=2% total inference-time regression. Parameter reduction alone is not sufficient.

nearest_work.difference: Closest implementation, not external priority evidence. Inherits the same compressed histories, orthogonal constructor projection, learned coordinates and hoisted evaluation. Move only training coordinate arithmetic into the first-affine module; add a separately controlled direct evaluator.

Plain quotient stores independently trainable effective q/k weights. Candidate keeps the orthogonal A/B parameters and maps weights differentiably inside the scorer, including detached auxiliary functional_call; matching effective initialization does not match subsequent plain-coordinate Adam updates.

predictions: At shared parameter states in real arithmetic, explicit orthogonal and weight-mapped first-affine outputs and derivatives agree; host FP32 differences should be numerical only. BF16 cast/rounding sites differ and may cause a quality failure after training.

The wrapper adds zero trainable parameters: reduced scorer retains194419 dense,31793216 embedding and31987635 total,6144 fewer parameters than native (3.063% of native dense;0.0192% total). There are no hidden full-weight buffers.

Moving repeated coordinate transforms to the small weight should reduce training intermediates and may lower training wall time compared with explicit orthogonal; this does not predict lower inference time for the unchanged hoisted evaluator.

Direct evaluation has one first-affine GEMM instead of two plus output summation. At key96/action16/30 slots it uses30*304 versus96+30*208 input-width-row units, a1.4394 ratio. A speedup supports a launch/intermediate-cost explanation only locally; a slowdown supports the arithmetic-cost alternative.

The two weight-execution candidates have identical training code, initialization and state layout. At fixed host seed their learned parameters and running states should be identical before validation; any difference needs diagnosis. Native and explicit replay quality should reproduce their known scores within1e-6 before accepting comparisons.
falsifiers: Any input/mask/label/gradient-ownership violation, mismatched optimizer registration, auxiliary persistent BN update, unexpected source/config mismatch, or no finite host preflight invalidates the comparison rather than disproving the scientific hypothesis.

A native-relative click AUC loss>0.000100 rejects preservation for the implementation; no posthoc relaxation based on original weaker entry AUC. If comparable host repetitions show consistent loss, treat capacity/rounding utility as unsupported within this recipe.

No reproducible>=2% p50 reduction with<=2% p95 and total-inference-time regression rejects prediction-latency utility even if training becomes faster, peak memory decreases or parameter counts fall. Prior orthogonal cost failure remains recorded.

If weight execution does not improve training cost over explicit orthogonal, expanded input transforms are not a consequential measured bottleneck for this implementation. If direct evaluation is slower, fewer launches are insufficient to compensate for its added arithmetic.

If FP32 stored-coordinate/input derivatives differ materially at mapped shared states, the implementation fails its algebraic control; do not interpret its performance as support for the intended transform.
alternative_explanations: BF16 input-cast versus weight-map rounding changes effective scores, gradient clipping and later Adam/embedding updates; equal real-arithmetic derivatives do not establish equal mixed-precision optimization.

GPU contention, launch scheduling, power/thermal state, loader overhead and run order can explain single timing receipts. Native and explicit contemporaneous replay plus repeated host timing are required; cross-round training differences are descriptive.

A preserved AUC may reflect fixed-seed behavior or selection from many prior trials; repeated exposures share users. Use paired user-cluster intervals only if host-authorized prediction/group data are exposed, otherwise report their absence.

Fewer parameters can reflect redundant linear coordinates, while useful nonlinear width is retained. Existing width50 and failed width56 controls support a discriminating comparison but do not establish necessity, an optimizer mechanism or external novelty.

The direct evaluator changes BF16 accumulation and bias-addition order in addition to launch count. Inspect same-checkpoint output/AUC and timing differences before interpreting its operation-count tradeoff.

Inherited auxiliary AUCs are substantially below the initial DIN reference; click preservation is the stated selection objective, not four-task Pareto dominance. Keep all auxiliary metrics and offline-visibility limitations visible.
